connector.name: MCP Server by true402.dev
connector.registryDescription: Pay-per-call AI + web + on-chain tools over x402 (USDC on Base): LLM, SEO, extract, token safety.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.true402, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Funded Base wallet private key for x402 payment signing (optional; without it, paid tools return the 402 requirements).

env.name: SERVER_URL
env.description: true402 API base (default https://true402.dev/api). Must be https (or localhost) — the signer refuses to send a payment over cleartext.

env.name: MAX_PAYMENT_USDC
env.description: Client-side per-call spend ceiling in USDC (default 0.10). The signer refuses to auto-pay a 402 whose amount exceeds this — protects the wallet from a hostile endpoint.
